name: window-switcher-current-screen
title: Window Switcher on Current Screen
description: Switch between windows filtered to the screen under your mouse cursor, and warp the cursor between screens.
author: nilleb

commands.name: switch-windows
commands.title: Switch Windows on Current Screen
commands.description: List windows on the screen under the cursor (or all screens) and focus one.

preferences.name: defaultScope
preferences.title: Default Scope
preferences.description: Which windows to show when the command opens.

commands.name: focus-next-screen
commands.title: Focus Next Screen
commands.description: Move the mouse cursor to the center of the next screen (cyclic).

commands.name: focus-previous-screen
commands.title: Focus Previous Screen
commands.description: Move the mouse cursor to the center of the previous screen (cyclic).
